About Me

Behind the lens,
on the boundary

I'm a sports broadcast cameraman specialising in live cricket coverage. I've operated cameras for international tournaments run by the ICC and the Asian Cricket Council, as well as local leagues and club competitions.

I'm also part of MSA Sports Video Production, a sports video production company delivering live streams and broadcast coverage for cricket tournaments in India and overseas.

From wide master shots to tight player close-ups and crowd reactions, my job is to make sure viewers at home never miss a moment of the action.
